author: @adrian.factomaton
scope: Finite authored routing criteria and detached review-history projection only; no implemented router or active-library change.

roles.disclosure: Requested reviewer authored candidate; shares owner Adrian and prior source exposure with proposal author/source reviewer. Design review only, not independent factual review or non-author curation.

review_notes: Author proposed supported verdict only. New exact candidate has no review; previous prose review abstained on the full compound claim and later supplement accepted only scoped supplied-copy technical content. Neither decision is inherited.

current_exact_source_review.scope: Exact C007a/v3 source-bound conjunction of sea-level ranking, dated joint 2020 snow-surface announcement, and reported orthometric/IHRS method.
current_exact_source_review.attachment: Only after exact claim/version/artifact/digest/raw-record/post-revision AND exact detached-review raw hash match. Reject mismatch, ambiguity or a later correction/withdrawal; prior-version decisions never substitute.

proposed_projection.historical_note_policy: Keep frozen record bytes unchanged. Projection labels the original no-review note as creation-time history, retains all substantive source limitations as current. Do not globally drop arbitrary strings or infer acceptance from text.

source_dependence: S3a/S2 and optional S5 relay share 2020 Nepal-China campaign; NOAA ranking lineage untraced. Snow label is not in paper final-result passages. No independent campaign count.
gates_before_any_answer: separate non-author curation decision for exact candidate and attached review
consumer schema adapter and review-history integration with regression evidence
growth/active-snapshot checks and explicit API publication consent
fixture_semantics: All cases currently withhold answer. eligible_after_gates denotes a proposed route only after every gate; no measured runtime results, factual recheck, general NLU guarantee or benchmark accuracy. Clarify/outside_scope are coverage dispositions, not claims that a query premise is false.

fixtures.query: Which summit is highest above global mean sea level?
fixtures.required_constraint: Sea-level ranking only; no current precise height.

fixtures.query: What snow-surface height did Nepal and China jointly announce on 2020-12-08?
fixtures.required_constraint: 8848.86 m as dated announcement, not present measurement.

fixtures.query: How does the participating Nepal report describe the height method and reference system?
fixtures.required_constraint: Reported orthometric height and IHRS; no independent validation.
Ask sea level, base-to-peak or Earth-centre distance.
Clarify date and surface; do not silently answer current height from 2020.

fixtures.query: What is Everest’s exact height today?
fixtures.required_constraint: No current measurement or invariant height supported.

fixtures.query: Is Everest taller from base to peak than Mauna Kea?
fixtures.required_constraint: C007b metric; do not inherit C007a review.

fixtures.query: Is Everest the farthest summit from Earth’s centre?
Did Everest grow by the difference between the 2005 rock height and 2020 snow height?
fixtures.required_constraint: No growth inference from different surfaces or campaigns.

fixtures.query: Is the 2020 height independently accurate to one centimetre?
fixtures.required_constraint: No numerical accuracy or independent remeasurement certification.

fixtures.query: Does the Nepal paper itself identify its final height as snow surface?
fixtures.required_constraint: P3 report does not supply snow label; P2 official announcement supplies it.

fixtures.query: Does NOAA’s rounded 8848 m prove the exact 8848.86 m announcement?
fixtures.required_constraint: S1 ranking is not the exact-number source.

fixtures.query: Were the Nepal and China results independent repeated measurements?
fixtures.required_constraint: Shared joint campaign; no independent-origin badge.

fixtures.query: What averaging weights produced the joint figure?
fixtures.required_constraint: Omitted averaging statements are not inherited.

fixtures.query: Which original Nepal letter and original MNR report did this review validate?
fixtures.required_constraint: Original Nepal letter and original MNR technical source unchecked.

binding_negative_criteria: prior prose abstention substituted for v3 review
limited supplied-copy acceptance substituted for v3 review
later correction or withdrawal not reconciled
validation: Author checked local frozen bindings and fixture structure only; fixture expectations are authored, not router execution results.
